comparison.objective: Grind peppercorns while stabilizing a mortar; candidate screens finishing media.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hold-and-grind tool motion versus bimanual load sharing, tilting, and granular bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: All peppercorns ground and pestle returned versus media recovered and washers retained without spill.
comparison.reason: Particle presence and agitation are superficial similarities; grinding does not perform selective separation.
